identity.title: [v0.92][WP-01][readiness] Complete design-time cards for every milestone issue

values.task_boundary: Repair and prove child design-time readiness without executing child deliverables.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: No child retains placeholder design or generic planning scaffolds
AC-2: Every child design is source-grounded and approved at its exact digest
AC-3: Every SIP, STP, SPP, and VPP is issue-specific and schema-valid
AC-4: Every SRP and SOR remains truthful pre-execution state
AC-5: Dependencies, owned paths, non-goals, rollback, and validation lanes are explicit for all children
AC-6: Preparation claims are released after validation and no product implementation begins
AC-7: Independent review finds no actionable readiness gap
